title: Internal Revenue Manual 20.1.2, Failure To File/Failure To Pay Penalties

passages.question: Does a valid extension into 2027 move this return to the higher penalty amount?
passages.excerpt: For returns due between January 1, 2026 and December 31, 2026 (without regard to extensions) the base penalty rate is $255.

passages.question: Could a late filing penalty be relieved?
passages.excerpt: The partnership must consist of 10 or fewer partners.
